extracted.name: Stef's Super Cheesy Garlic Bread
extracted.description: This super cheesy garlic bread is made with two types of cheese mixed with green onions, garlic, and mayonnaise to create an incredible tasting bread.
ingredient_lines: 1 (1 pound) loaf French bread, halved lengthwise
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Mix together butter, mayonnaise, green onions, garlic, Parmesan cheese, and Monterey Jack cheese in a large bowl until well combined.
Cut each French bread half into 4 pieces. Spread cheese mixture evenly over each bread piece.
Bake in the preheated oven for 8 minutes. Turn the broiler to high. Broil until hot and bubbly, about 2 more minutes.
